description: Scoped Markdown document CLI for the pinned MarkText application.

analysis.recipe: Retained REA source analysis, bounded main/preload/renderer inspection, and current-run editor-store probes establish native mappings. Module: adapters/marktext/adapter.mjs. Journey execution remains pending; complete application coverage is not claimed.

capabilities.description: Open owned Markdown files and read persisted content, native buffers, and editor text.
capabilities.reason: Native IPC, preload reads, and editor-store access are established; journey execution is pending.

capabilities.description: Replace active document content through loadChange and persist through FILE_SAVE.
capabilities.reason: Observed application actions provide separate buffer and persisted-file mutations.

capabilities.description: Reopen saved documents and restore supplied scratch content through application actions.
capabilities.reason: Uses native tab closure, opening, content loading, and saving; unrelated owned documents are checked.
This adapter operates on existing fixture inputs; destination selection and deletion are not implemented.
Complete destination and result mappings are outside this bounded implementation.

capabilities.description: Projects, settings, uploads, publishing, and other application areas.
capabilities.reason: Excluded from this document adapter; complete application coverage is not claimed.

document.open.description: Open or select an existing owned Markdown document.

document.read.description: Read persisted content and any open native buffer without changing selection.

document.edit.description: Replace the active owned UTF-8/LF document buffer through the editor action.

document.save.description: Persist the active owned UTF-8/LF buffer through native saving.

document.reopen.description: Close only the saved target tab and reload its persisted document.

document.restore.description: Open the owned scratch document, restore supplied content, and save natively; repeatable cleanup.
